name: Publish Today's Posts
description: Manually trigger publishing of all posts scheduled for today.

then.prompt: Query the posts table in agent/mainstay.db for all posts where scheduled_date = today and status = 'scheduled'. For each post: 1) Retrieve the asset filepath and caption from the database. 2) Attempt to publish using Playwright for the correct platform (tiktok, instagram_reel, instagram_story, instagram_feed, or whatsapp). 3) Save a confirmation screenshot to agent/screenshots/. 4) Update the post status to 'published' or 'manual-required' depending on result. 5) Print a summary of what was published and what needs manual action.
